metrics.title: Three-point scoring dependence
metrics.explain: Share of points earned from three-pointers. This is not simply the share of shots attempted.

metrics.title: Points from the free-throw line
metrics.explain: Share of the team’s points that came from free throws.

metrics.title: Inside-the-arc point share
metrics.explain: Scoring from two-point shots, whether inside or outside the paint. Not a paint-only statistic.

metrics.title: Points produced per field-goal try
metrics.explain: Total points relative to how many field goals were attempted. Includes free-throw points; not shot efficiency alone.

metrics.title: Three-point vs. free-throw scoring
metrics.explain: How much three-point scoring contributed compared with free throws. If no free throws were made, the denominator is one for display only.
metrics.formula: Three-point points ÷ max(1, made free throws)

metrics.title: Offensive boards per 100 missed shots
metrics.explain: A rough second-chance indicator. This is NOT official offensive-rebound percentage.
metrics.formula: Offensive rebounds ÷ missed team field goals × 100

metrics.title: Turnover burden per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: How often opportunities ended in a turnover, using a standard estimated-possession formula.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Points per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: An approximation of offensive efficiency based on box-score possessions, not an official possession count.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Recoveries minus mistakes
metrics.explain: Offensive rebounds plus recorded steals, minus turnovers. These are event counts, NOT exact extra possessions.

metrics.title: Turnover swing
metrics.explain: How many more turnovers the opponent committed than this team.

metrics.title: Free-throw scoring advantage
metrics.explain: The point difference earned from made free throws alone.
metrics.formula: Own free throws made − opponent free throws made

metrics.title: Three-pointer point advantage
metrics.explain: The scoring gap created by made threes, ignoring two-pointers and free throws.

metrics.title: Extra shot attempts
metrics.explain: How many more or fewer field-goal attempts the team got. Not all attempts were equally valuable.

metrics.title: Assisted-basket share
metrics.explain: Approximately how often a made basket was recorded with an assist.

metrics.title: Won despite worse shot efficiency
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team had lower effective field-goal percentage than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner eFG% is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite fewer made baskets
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team made fewer field goals than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner FGM is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite being outrebounded
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team grabbed fewer total rebounds.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner rebounds are lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Lead exchanges

metrics.title: Points from the free-throw line

metrics.title: Inside-the-arc point share

metrics.title: Points from the free-throw line
metrics.explain: Share of the team’s points that came from free throws.

metrics.title: Inside-the-arc point share
metrics.explain: Scoring from two-point shots, whether inside or outside the paint. Not a paint-only statistic.

metrics.title: Points produced per field-goal try
metrics.explain: Total points relative to how many field goals were attempted. Includes free-throw points; not shot efficiency alone.

metrics.title: Three-point vs. free-throw scoring
metrics.explain: How much three-point scoring contributed compared with free throws. If no free throws were made, the denominator is one for display only.
metrics.formula: Three-point points ÷ max(1, made free throws)

metrics.title: Offensive boards per 100 missed shots
metrics.explain: A rough second-chance indicator. This is NOT official offensive-rebound percentage.
metrics.formula: Offensive rebounds ÷ missed team field goals × 100

metrics.title: Turnover burden per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: How often opportunities ended in a turnover, using a standard estimated-possession formula.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Points per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: An approximation of offensive efficiency based on box-score possessions, not an official possession count.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Recoveries minus mistakes
metrics.explain: Offensive rebounds plus recorded steals, minus turnovers. These are event counts, NOT exact extra possessions.

metrics.title: Turnover swing
metrics.explain: How many more turnovers the opponent committed than this team.

metrics.title: Free-throw scoring advantage
metrics.explain: The point difference earned from made free throws alone.
metrics.formula: Own free throws made − opponent free throws made

metrics.title: Three-pointer point advantage
metrics.explain: The scoring gap created by made threes, ignoring two-pointers and free throws.

metrics.title: Extra shot attempts
metrics.explain: How many more or fewer field-goal attempts the team got. Not all attempts were equally valuable.

metrics.title: Assisted-basket share
metrics.explain: Approximately how often a made basket was recorded with an assist.

metrics.title: Won despite worse shot efficiency
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team had lower effective field-goal percentage than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner eFG% is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite fewer made baskets
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team made fewer field goals than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner FGM is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite being outrebounded
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team grabbed fewer total rebounds.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner rebounds are lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Single-player scoring load
metrics.explain: Anthony Davis · provided this share of the team’s points.
metrics.formula: Team top scorer points ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Two-player scoring takeover
metrics.explain: Anthony Davis + AJ Dybantsa: combined share of team points.
metrics.formula: Two highest individual point totals ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Three-player scoring concentration
metrics.explain: The combined percentage of points produced by the top three scorers.
metrics.formula: Three highest scoring totals ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Most points per minute
metrics.explain: Anthony Davis · 25 points in 34 minutes; requires at least 10 played minutes.
metrics.formula: Points ÷ minutes for highest-rate player with ≥10 min

metrics.title: Most minutes without scoring
metrics.explain: Will Riley · spent 10 minutes playing without scoring. This does not measure defense or all-around impact.
metrics.formula: Longest minutes among players with 0 points

metrics.title: Number of double-digit scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates scored at least 10 points.

metrics.title: Number of 20-point scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates reached 20 points.

metrics.title: Scoring beyond the five busiest players
metrics.explain: Points scored by players outside the five highest-minute players. This does NOT claim that they were officially bench players.
metrics.formula: Points by players ranked sixth or lower in minutes ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Gamewide three-point dependency
metrics.explain: Share of every point scored in this game that came from made three-pointers.
metrics.formula: Both teams’ made threes × 3 ÷ combined points × 100

metrics.title: Winning margin
metrics.explain: The number of points separating the two teams at the final buzzer.

metrics.title: Largest unanswered burst
metrics.explain: Most consecutive points without the opponent scoring.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Largest unanswered burst
metrics.explain: Most consecutive points without the opponent scoring.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Best 60-second scoring burst
metrics.explain: Most points a team scored within any 60 seconds of game clock.
metrics.formula: Maximum team points in rolling 60 game-clock seconds
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Best 60-second scoring burst
metrics.explain: Most points a team scored within any 60 seconds of game clock.
metrics.formula: Maximum team points in rolling 60 game-clock seconds
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Lead exchanges
metrics.explain: Times the lead changed directly or after a tie. Ties are not counted as lead changes.
metrics.formula: Count of changes in nonzero lead sign after scoring plays
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Scoreboard ties
metrics.explain: Scoring plays that brought the teams level, excluding the initial 0–0.
metrics.formula: Count of scoring plays with equal final displayed score
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Largest lead
metrics.explain: Biggest advantage this team held during the game.
metrics.formula: Maximum own score minus opponent score
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Largest lead
metrics.explain: Biggest advantage this team held during the game.
metrics.formula: Maximum own score minus opponent score
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Biggest deficit overcome by winner
metrics.explain: Largest hole the eventual winner climbed out of during the game.
metrics.formula: Maximum opponent lead before final winner
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Longest scoring drought
metrics.explain: Longest stretch without scoring measured on game clock, not wall-clock broadcast time.
metrics.formula: Largest game-clock gap between scoring events, including start/end
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Longest scoring drought
metrics.explain: Longest stretch without scoring measured on game clock, not wall-clock broadcast time.
metrics.formula: Largest game-clock gap between scoring events, including start/end
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Final three-minute output
metrics.explain: Points scored in the last 3:00 of regulation, not including overtime.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Final three-minute output
metrics.explain: Points scored in the last 3:00 of regulation, not including overtime.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Quarter-to-quarter seesaw
metrics.explain: Difference between the most home-favorable and most away-favorable regulation quarter.
metrics.formula: Maximum Q1–Q4 home margin minus minimum Q1–Q4 home margin
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Halftime adjustment swing
metrics.explain: Change in home-team point differential from second quarter to third quarter. This measures a score change, not coaching causation.
metrics.formula: Q3 home margin − Q2 home margin
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Points per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: An approximation of offensive efficiency based on box-score possessions, not an official possession count.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Recoveries minus mistakes
metrics.explain: Offensive rebounds plus recorded steals, minus turnovers. These are event counts, NOT exact extra possessions.

metrics.title: Turnover swing
metrics.explain: How many more turnovers the opponent committed than this team.

metrics.title: Free-throw scoring advantage
metrics.explain: The point difference earned from made free throws alone.
metrics.formula: Own free throws made − opponent free throws made

metrics.title: Three-pointer point advantage
metrics.explain: The scoring gap created by made threes, ignoring two-pointers and free throws.

metrics.title: Extra shot attempts
metrics.explain: How many more or fewer field-goal attempts the team got. Not all attempts were equally valuable.

metrics.title: Assisted-basket share
metrics.explain: Approximately how often a made basket was recorded with an assist.

metrics.title: Won despite worse shot efficiency
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team had lower effective field-goal percentage than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner eFG% is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite fewer made baskets
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team made fewer field goals than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner FGM is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite being outrebounded
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team grabbed fewer total rebounds.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner rebounds are lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Single-player scoring load
metrics.explain: Paul George · provided this share of the team’s points.
metrics.formula: Team top scorer points ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Two-player scoring takeover
metrics.explain: Paul George + Jayson Tatum: combined share of team points.
metrics.formula: Two highest individual point totals ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Three-player scoring concentration
metrics.explain: The combined percentage of points produced by the top three scorers.
metrics.formula: Three highest scoring totals ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Most points per minute
metrics.explain: Paul George · 27 points in 28 minutes; requires at least 10 played minutes.
metrics.formula: Points ÷ minutes for highest-rate player with ≥10 min

metrics.title: Most minutes without scoring
metrics.explain: Jordan Walsh · spent 11 minutes playing without scoring. This does not measure defense or all-around impact.
metrics.formula: Longest minutes among players with 0 points

metrics.title: Number of double-digit scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates scored at least 10 points.

metrics.title: Number of 20-point scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates reached 20 points.

metrics.title: Scoring beyond the five busiest players
metrics.explain: Points scored by players outside the five highest-minute players. This does NOT claim that they were officially bench players.
metrics.formula: Points by players ranked sixth or lower in minutes ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Gamewide three-point dependency
metrics.explain: Share of every point scored in this game that came from made three-pointers.
metrics.formula: Both teams’ made threes × 3 ÷ combined points × 100

metrics.title: Winning margin
metrics.explain: The number of points separating the two teams at the final buzzer.

metrics.title: Largest unanswered burst

metrics.title: Best 60-second scoring burst

metrics.title: Lead exchanges

metrics.title: Quarter-to-quarter seesaw

metrics.title: Number of 20-point scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates reached 20 points.

metrics.title: Scoring beyond the five busiest players
metrics.explain: Points scored by players outside the five highest-minute players. This does NOT claim that they were officially bench players.
metrics.formula: Points by players ranked sixth or lower in minutes ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Gamewide three-point dependency
metrics.explain: Share of every point scored in this game that came from made three-pointers.
metrics.formula: Both teams’ made threes × 3 ÷ combined points × 100

metrics.title: Winning margin
metrics.explain: The number of points separating the two teams at the final buzzer.

metrics.title: Three-point scoring dependence
metrics.explain: Share of points earned from three-pointers. This is not simply the share of shots attempted.

metrics.title: Points from the free-throw line
metrics.explain: Share of the team’s points that came from free throws.

metrics.title: Inside-the-arc point share
metrics.explain: Scoring from two-point shots, whether inside or outside the paint. Not a paint-only statistic.

metrics.title: Points produced per field-goal try
metrics.explain: Total points relative to how many field goals were attempted. Includes free-throw points; not shot efficiency alone.

metrics.title: Three-point vs. free-throw scoring
metrics.explain: How much three-point scoring contributed compared with free throws. If no free throws were made, the denominator is one for display only.
metrics.formula: Three-point points ÷ max(1, made free throws)

metrics.title: Offensive boards per 100 missed shots
metrics.explain: A rough second-chance indicator. This is NOT official offensive-rebound percentage.
metrics.formula: Offensive rebounds ÷ missed team field goals × 100

metrics.title: Turnover burden per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: How often opportunities ended in a turnover, using a standard estimated-possession formula.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Points per 100 estimated possessions
metrics.explain: An approximation of offensive efficiency based on box-score possessions, not an official possession count.
metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Recoveries minus mistakes
metrics.explain: Offensive rebounds plus recorded steals, minus turnovers. These are event counts, NOT exact extra possessions.

metrics.title: Turnover swing
metrics.explain: How many more turnovers the opponent committed than this team.

metrics.title: Free-throw scoring advantage
metrics.explain: The point difference earned from made free throws alone.
metrics.formula: Own free throws made − opponent free throws made

metrics.title: Three-pointer point advantage
metrics.explain: The scoring gap created by made threes, ignoring two-pointers and free throws.

metrics.title: Extra shot attempts
metrics.explain: How many more or fewer field-goal attempts the team got. Not all attempts were equally valuable.

metrics.title: Assisted-basket share
metrics.explain: Approximately how often a made basket was recorded with an assist.

metrics.title: Won despite worse shot efficiency
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team had lower effective field-goal percentage than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner eFG% is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite fewer made baskets

metrics.title: Won despite being outrebounded

metrics.formula: 1 if winner rebounds are lower; otherwise 0

metrics.source: Validated game box score · possession estimate

metrics.title: Recoveries minus mistakes
metrics.explain: Offensive rebounds plus recorded steals, minus turnovers. These are event counts, NOT exact extra possessions.

metrics.title: Turnover swing
metrics.explain: How many more turnovers the opponent committed than this team.

metrics.title: Free-throw scoring advantage
metrics.explain: The point difference earned from made free throws alone.
metrics.formula: Own free throws made − opponent free throws made

metrics.title: Three-pointer point advantage
metrics.explain: The scoring gap created by made threes, ignoring two-pointers and free throws.

metrics.title: Extra shot attempts
metrics.explain: How many more or fewer field-goal attempts the team got. Not all attempts were equally valuable.

metrics.title: Assisted-basket share
metrics.explain: Approximately how often a made basket was recorded with an assist.

metrics.title: Won despite worse shot efficiency
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team had lower effective field-goal percentage than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner eFG% is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite fewer made baskets
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team made fewer field goals than the loser.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner FGM is lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Won despite being outrebounded
metrics.explain: Whether the winning team grabbed fewer total rebounds.
metrics.formula: 1 if winner rebounds are lower; otherwise 0

metrics.title: Single-player scoring load
metrics.explain: Jaden McDaniels · provided this share of the team’s points.
metrics.formula: Team top scorer points ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Two-player scoring takeover
metrics.explain: Jaden McDaniels + Anthony Edwards: combined share of team points.
metrics.formula: Two highest individual point totals ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Three-player scoring concentration
metrics.explain: The combined percentage of points produced by the top three scorers.
metrics.formula: Three highest scoring totals ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Most points per minute
metrics.explain: Joan Beringer · 9 points in 15 minutes; requires at least 10 played minutes.
metrics.formula: Points ÷ minutes for highest-rate player with ≥10 min

metrics.title: Number of double-digit scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates scored at least 10 points.

metrics.title: Number of 20-point scorers
metrics.explain: How many teammates reached 20 points.

metrics.title: Scoring beyond the five busiest players
metrics.explain: Points scored by players outside the five highest-minute players. This does NOT claim that they were officially bench players.
metrics.formula: Points by players ranked sixth or lower in minutes ÷ team points × 100

metrics.title: Gamewide three-point dependency
metrics.explain: Share of every point scored in this game that came from made three-pointers.
metrics.formula: Both teams’ made threes × 3 ÷ combined points × 100

metrics.title: Winning margin
metrics.explain: The number of points separating the two teams at the final buzzer.

metrics.title: Largest unanswered burst
metrics.explain: Most consecutive points without the opponent scoring.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Best 60-second scoring burst
metrics.explain: Most points a team scored within any 60 seconds of game clock.
metrics.formula: Maximum team points in rolling 60 game-clock seconds
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Best 60-second scoring burst
metrics.explain: Most points a team scored within any 60 seconds of game clock.
metrics.formula: Maximum team points in rolling 60 game-clock seconds
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Lead exchanges
metrics.explain: Times the lead changed directly or after a tie. Ties are not counted as lead changes.
metrics.formula: Count of changes in nonzero lead sign after scoring plays
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Scoreboard ties
metrics.explain: Scoring plays that brought the teams level, excluding the initial 0–0.
metrics.formula: Count of scoring plays with equal final displayed score
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Largest lead
metrics.explain: Biggest advantage this team held during the game.
metrics.formula: Maximum own score minus opponent score
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Largest lead
metrics.explain: Biggest advantage this team held during the game.

metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Biggest deficit overcome by winner
metrics.explain: Largest hole the eventual winner climbed out of during the game.
metrics.formula: Maximum opponent lead before final winner
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Longest scoring drought
metrics.explain: Longest stretch without scoring measured on game clock, not wall-clock broadcast time.
metrics.formula: Largest game-clock gap between scoring events, including start/end
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Longest scoring drought
metrics.explain: Longest stretch without scoring measured on game clock, not wall-clock broadcast time.
metrics.formula: Largest game-clock gap between scoring events, including start/end
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Final three-minute output
metrics.explain: Points scored in the last 3:00 of regulation, not including overtime.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Final three-minute output
metrics.explain: Points scored in the last 3:00 of regulation, not including overtime.
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Quarter-to-quarter seesaw
metrics.explain: Difference between the most home-favorable and most away-favorable regulation quarter.
metrics.formula: Maximum Q1–Q4 home margin minus minimum Q1–Q4 home margin
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Halftime adjustment swing
metrics.explain: Change in home-team point differential from second quarter to third quarter. This measures a score change, not coaching causation.
metrics.formula: Q3 home margin − Q2 home margin
metrics.source: Verified ESPN play-by-play; score timeline reconciled to final result

metrics.title: Three-point scoring dependence

metrics.title: Points from the free-throw line

metrics.title: Inside-the-arc point share
metrics.explain: Scoring from two-point shots, whether inside or outside the paint. Not a paint-only statistic.

metrics.title: Points produced per field-goal try
metrics.explain: Total points relative to how many field goals were attempted. Includes free-throw points; not shot efficiency alone.

metrics.title: Three-point vs. free-throw scoring
metrics.explain: How much three-point scoring contributed compared with free throws. If no free throws were made, the denominator is one for display only.
metrics.formula: Three-point points ÷ max(1, made free throws)
